US.description: Effective rate including federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average state income tax.

IN.description: Includes central income tax and 4% health and education cess for an individual under the new tax regime, assuming no other deductions.

SG.description: Progressive individual income tax on gross earnings.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions, varying by canton and municipality.

NL.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax and national insurance contributions, accounting for general tax credits for a single earner.

GB.description: Includes income tax and national insurance contributions for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income tax, plus mandatory contributions for Canada Pension Plan (CPP) and Employment Insurance (EI).

AE.description: No personal income tax for residents.

NO.description: Includes national income tax, municipal tax, and social security contributions.

IE.description: Includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI).

LU.description: Effective tax rate includes national income tax and mandatory social security contributions for an $85k USD equivalent earner.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax and Medicare levy for an $85k USD equivalent earner in Australia.

QA.description: Qatar has no personal income tax for individuals.

BN.description: Brunei Darussalam does not impose personal income tax on its residents or foreign nationals.

MO.description: Effective tax rate includes progressive complementary tax with a high exemption threshold. Macao has a low tax regime with no VAT or sales tax.
